Please implement the following feature:
When a user is creating an account, once they get to the email verification page, they have the option to select a different email. Please implement the ability for the "use different email" buttont to return to the previous page with the email entry, and persist the already entered username, email, and password, so that the user can easily change the email without having to redo the whole signup process

26	export default async function handler(body: Record<string, string>) {
27	  const { email, password, language, token } = signupSchema.parse(body);
28	
29	  const userRepository = getUserRepository()
30	
31	  const username = slugify(body.username);
32	  const userEmail = email.toLowerCase();
33	
34	  if (!username) {
35	    return NextResponse.json({ message: "Invalid username" }, { status: 422 });
36	  }
37	
38	  let foundToken: { id: number; teamId: number | null; expires: Date } | null = null;
39	  let correctedUsername = username;
40	  if (token) {
41	    foundToken = await findTokenByToken({ token });
42	    throwIfTokenExpired(foundToken?.expires);
43	    correctedUsername = await validateAndGetCorrectedUsernameForTeam({
44	      username,
45	      email: userEmail,
46	      teamId: foundToken?.teamId,
47	      isSignup: true,
48	    });
49	
50	    if (foundToken?.teamId) {
51	      const existingUser = await userRepository.findByEmailWithInvitedTo({
52	        email: userEmail
53	      })
54	
55	      if (existingUser && existingUser.invitedTo !== foundToken.teamId) {
56	        return NextResponse.json({ message: SIGNUP_ERROR_CODES.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS }, { status: 409 });
57	      }
58	    }
59	  } else {
60	    const userValidation = await validateAndGetCorrectedUsernameAndEmail({
61	      username,
62	      email: userEmail,
63	      isSignup: true,
64	    });
65	    if (!userValidation.isValid) {
66	      logger.error("User validation failed", { userValidation });
67	      return NextResponse.json({ message: "Username or email is already taken" }, { status: 409 });
68	    }
69	    if (!userValidation.username) {
70	      return NextResponse.json({ message: "Invalid username" }, { status: 422 });
71	    }
72	    correctedUsername = userValidation.username;
73	  }
74	
75	  const hashedPassword = await hashPassword(password);
76	
77	  if (foundToken?.teamId) {
78	    const team = await prisma.team.findUnique({
79	      where: {
80	        id: foundToken.teamId,
81	      },
82	      include: {
83	        parent: {
84	          select: {
85	            id: true,
86	            slug: true,
87	            organizationSettings: true,
88	          },
89	        },
90	        organizationSettings: true,
91	      },
92	    });
93	
94	    if (team) {
95	      const isInviteForATeamInOrganization = !!team.parent;
96	      const isCheckingUsernameInGlobalNamespace = !team.isOrganization && !isInviteForATeamInOrganization;
97	
98	      if (isCheckingUsernameInGlobalNamespace) {
99	        const isUsernameAvailable = !(await isUsernameReservedDueToMigration(correctedUsername));
100	        if (!isUsernameAvailable) {
101	          return NextResponse.json({ message: "A user exists with that username" }, { status: 409 });
102	        }
103	      }
104	
105	      const organizationId = team.isOrganization ? team.id : (team.parent?.id ?? null);
106	
107	      const existingUserByUsername = await userRepository.findByUsernameAndOrganizationId({
108	        username: correctedUsername,
109	        organizationId,
110	        excludeEmail: userEmail
111	      })
112	
113	      if (existingUserByUsername) {
114	        return NextResponse.json({ message: SIGNUP_ERROR_CODES.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS }, { status: 409 });
115	      }
116	
117	      let user: { id: number };
118	      try {
119	        user = await userRepository.upsertForSignup({
120	          email: userEmail,
121	          username: correctedUsername,
122	          hashedPassword,
123	          organizationId,
124	          emailVerified: new Date(Date.now()),
125	          identityProvider: IdentityProvider.CAL
126	        })
127	      } catch (error) {
128	        if (isPrismaError(error) && error.code === "P2002") {
129	          const target = String(error.meta?.target ?? "");
130	          if (target.includes("email") || target.includes("username")) {
131	            return NextResponse.json({ message: SIGNUP_ERROR_CODES.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS }, { status: 409 });
132	          }
133	        }
134	        throw error;
135	      }
136	
137	      await createOrUpdateMemberships({

139	        team,
140	      });
141	
142	      // Accept any child team invites for orgs.
143	      if (team.parent) {
144	        await joinAnyChildTeamOnOrgInvite({

146	          org: team.parent,
147	        });
148	      }
149	    }

155	      },
156	    });
157	  } else {
158	    const isUsernameAvailable = !(await isUsernameReservedDueToMigration(correctedUsername));
159	    if (!isUsernameAvailable) {
160	      return NextResponse.json({ message: "A user exists with that username" }, { status: 409 });
161	    }
162	    try {

167	        organizationId: null,
168	        creationSource: CreationSource.WEBAPP,
169	        identityProvider: IdentityProvider.CAL,
170	        locked: false
171	      })
172	    } catch (error) {
173	      // Fallback for race conditions where user was created between our check and create
174	      if (isPrismaError(error) && error.code === "P2002") {
175	        const target = String(error.meta?.target ?? "");
176	        if (target.includes("email") || target.includes("username")) {
177	          return NextResponse.json({ message: SIGNUP_ERROR_CODES.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS }, { status: 409 });

4	export const getUsernameForOrgMember = async ({
5	  email,
6	  orgAutoAcceptEmail,
7	  isSignup,
8	  username,
9	}: {
10	  username?: string;
11	  email: string;
12	  orgAutoAcceptEmail?: string;
13	  isSignup: boolean;
14	}) => {
15	  if (isSignup) {
16	    // We ensure that the username is always derived from the email during signup.
17	    return getOrgUsernameFromEmail(email, orgAutoAcceptEmail || "");
18	  }
19	  if (!username) {
20	    throw new Error("Username is required");
21	  }
22	  // Right now it's not possible to change username in an org by the user but when that's allowed we would simply accept the provided username
23	  return username;
24	};
25	
26	export const validateAndGetCorrectedUsernameAndEmail = async ({
27	  username,
28	  email,
29	  organizationId,
30	  orgAutoAcceptEmail,
31	  isSignup,
32	}: {
33	  username: string;
34	  email: string;
35	  organizationId?: number;
36	  orgAutoAcceptEmail?: string;
37	  isSignup: boolean;
38	}) => {
39	  if (username.includes("+")) {
40	    return { isValid: false, username: undefined, email };
41	  }
42	  // There is an existingUser if, within an org context or not, the username matches
43	  // OR if the email matches AND either the email is verified
44	  // or both username and password are set
45	  const existingUser = await prisma.user.findFirst({
46	    where: {
47	      ...(organizationId ? { organizationId } : {}),
48	      OR: [
49	        // When inviting to org, invited user gets created with username now, so in an org context we
50	        // can't check for username as it will exist on signup
51	        ...(!organizationId ? [{ username }] : [{}]),
52	        {
53	          AND: [
54	            { email },
55	            {
56	              OR: [
57	                { emailVerified: { not: null } },
58	                { AND: [{ password: { isNot: null } }, { username: { not: null } }] },
59	              ],
60	            },
61	          ],
62	        },
63	      ],
64	    },
65	    select: {
66	      email: true,
67	    },
68	  });
69	  let validatedUsername = username;
70	  if (organizationId) {
71	    validatedUsername = await getUsernameForOrgMember({
72	      email,
73	      orgAutoAcceptEmail,
74	      isSignup,
75	    });
76	  }
77	
78	  return { isValid: !existingUser, username: validatedUsername, email: existingUser?.email };
79	};

import { sendEmailVerification } from "@calcom/features/auth/lib/verifyEmail";
import { checkRateLimitAndThrowError } from "@calcom/lib/checkRateLimitAndThrowError";
import logger from "@calcom/lib/logger";
import { prisma } from "@calcom/prisma";

import { TRPCError } from "@trpc/server";

import type { TRPCContext } from "../../../createContext";
import type { TrpcSessionUser } from "../../../types";
import type { TResendVerifyEmailSchema } from "./resendVerifyEmail.schema";

type ResendEmailOptions = {
  ctx: {
    user: NonNullable<TrpcSessionUser>;
    req: TRPCContext["req"] | undefined;
  };
  input: TResendVerifyEmailSchema;
};

const log = logger.getSubLogger({ prefix: [`[[Auth] `] });

export const resendVerifyEmail = async ({ input, ctx }: ResendEmailOptions) => {
  let emailToVerify = ctx.user.email;

  await checkRateLimitAndThrowError({
    rateLimitingType: "core",
    identifier: `resendVerifyEmail:${ctx.user.id}`,
  });

  let emailVerified = Boolean(ctx.user.emailVerified);
  let secondaryEmail: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof prisma.secondaryEmail.findUnique>> | undefined;
  // If the input which is coming is not the current user's email, it could be a secondary email
  if (input?.email && input?.email !== ctx.user.email) {
    secondaryEmail = await prisma.secondaryEmail.findUnique({
      where: {
        email: input.email,
        userId: ctx.user.id,
      },
    });

    if (!secondaryEmail) {
      throw new TRPCError({ code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: "Email not found" });
    }

    if (secondaryEmail.emailVerified) {
      emailVerified = true;
    } else {
      emailToVerify = input.email;
      emailVerified = false;
    }
  }
  if (emailVerified) {
    log.info(`User ${ctx.user.id} already verified email`);
    return {
      ok: true,
      skipped: true,
    };
  }

  const email = await sendEmailVerification({
    email: emailToVerify,
    username: ctx.user?.username ?? undefined,
    language: ctx.user.locale,
    secondaryEmailId: secondaryEmail?.id,
  });

  return email;
};

import { getUserRepository } from "@calcom/features/di/containers/UserRepository";

import { TRPCError } from "@trpc/server";

import type { TrpcSessionUser } from "../../../types";

// Only accounts that were just created and never verified may be discarded, so an older
// account that merely lacks verification can't be wiped through the "use different email" flow.
const MAX_ACCOUNT_AGE_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export const discardUnverifiedSignupHandler = async ({
  ctx,
}: {
  ctx: { user: NonNullable<TrpcSessionUser> };
}) => {
  const { id, emailVerified, createdDate } = ctx.user;
  if (emailVerified || Date.now() - new Date(createdDate).getTime() > MAX_ACCOUNT_AGE_MS) {
    throw new TRPCError({ code: "FORBIDDEN", message: "Only a new, unverified account can be discarded" });
  }

  await getUserRepository().deleteMany({ userIds: [id] });
  return { ok: true };
};

```

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import type { TrpcSessionUser } from "../../../types";
import { discardUnverifiedSignupHandler } from "./discardUnverifiedSignup.handler";

const deleteMany = vi.fn();
vi.mock("@calcom/features/di/containers/UserRepository", () => ({
  getUserRepository: () => ({ deleteMany }),
}));

const makeCtx = (user: { emailVerified: Date | null; createdDate: Date }) => ({
  user: { id: 7, ...user } as NonNullable<TrpcSessionUser>,
});

describe("discardUnverifiedSignupHandler", () => {
  beforeEach(() => deleteMany.mockReset());

  it("deletes a freshly created unverified account", async () => {
    await discardUnverifiedSignupHandler({ ctx: makeCtx({ emailVerified: null, createdDate: new Date() }) });
    expect(deleteMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ userIds: [7] });
  });

  it("refuses a verified account", async () => {
    await expect(
      discardUnverifiedSignupHandler({ ctx: makeCtx({ emailVerified: new Date(), createdDate: new Date() }) })
    ).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(deleteMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("refuses an old unverified account", async () => {
    const createdDate = new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    await expect(
      discardUnverifiedSignupHandler({ ctx: makeCtx({ emailVerified: null, createdDate }) })
    ).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(deleteMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-07 00:41:26Z)**_

I've implemented the feature, but it isn't fully checked yet. The new server-side check has a test, and its 3 cases pass. The TypeScript type check of `apps/web` is still running in the background, and I haven't tried the flow in a running app.

**What changed:** By the time someone reaches the verify-email page, their account has already been created, unverified. So if the form were just refilled and resubmitted, it would fail with "Username or email is already taken". To make "use different email" work, clicking it now:

1. Deletes the user's own unverified account.
2. Signs them out.
3. Returns them to `/signup` with the email form open and username, email and password filled in.

**Files:**
- [signup-view.tsx](apps/web/modules/signup-view.tsx): after a successful signup, the username, email and password are saved to `sessionStorage`. This only happens when email verification is on and it isn't an invite-link signup. When the signup page loads, it reads those values back into the form, opens the form, and deletes the saved copy.
- [verify-email-view.tsx](apps/web/modules/auth/verify-email-view.tsx): if saved signup values exist, the button calls the new delete step before signing out. Without them it signs out as before. The saved values are also cleared once the email is verified.
- New tRPC mutation `viewer.auth.discardUnverifiedSignup` ([handler](packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/auth/discardUnverifiedSignup.handler.ts), plus a [test](packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/auth/discardUnverifiedSignup.handler.test.ts)). It only deletes the account if the email is unverified **and** the account was created less than 24 hours ago. That stops an older unverified account from being wiped through this button.
- `SIGNUP_DRAFT_KEY` added to [constants.ts](packages/features/auth/signup/constants.ts).

**Decision for you:** The password is saved in plain text in `sessionStorage`. That storage belongs to the browser tab and is wiped when the tab closes; it's also cleared after it's read back or once the email is verified. But until then, any script running on the page could read it. Prefilling the password requires storing it this way. If you'd rather not, drop `password` from the saved values and users retype only that field.

Deleting the account is a hard delete, which is reasonable here because a brand-new unverified account has no data. Biome reports nothing on the lines I changed; both edited views had lint errors before this change, which I left alone.
